data.rationale: The proposed workflow follows the same EDGAR → Wikipedia → Mail sequence and uses the correct subject format. It hardcodes the recipient as "Dana" instead of parameterizing {manager}@example.com. It also leaves the final step ambiguous ("Discard/send" instead of "do not send, click Discard"), and it gives vague details for the form-type filter and the To/Subject/Body field interactions, so an automation would need guesses and could send the email by mistake.
